_tiers: M = MEASURED on the local B5 bench (out/measured*.csv; PostgreSQL 16.15, synthetic players, dense 2 km area, 14 days, rule set 1002 res 10). R = REPORTED by docs/G34_STORAGE_CAPACITY.md, not re-measured here. A = ASSUMED. Everything else is computed (PROJECTED) by calculator.ts.

quota._tier: nominalMiB: A (owner must confirm the real project quota); operationalReservePct: A (headroom for WAL, dashboard lag, migrations, restores); baselineMiB: R (live DB read on 18 Oct per G34 doc)

activity._tier: A (bench values; no pilot has run)

1001.label: rule 1001 (default): res 8 units, immediate flip, no challenges
1001._tier: unitsPerSession R (res 8 bench of rev 1); accepted rows A (no refusal rows in rev 3; 1001 has no take budget); no 1001 bench exists on revision 3, so 1001 is PROJECTED from per-row costs only

1002.label: rule 1002 (unratified alternative): res 10 units, two-day challenge, 13 takes/day
1002._tier: acceptedRowsPerSession M (111,918 rows / 12,666 sessions); challenge inserts per row per player M (2,064,813 inserts / 111,918 rows / 1,000 players, dense 2 km area; it grows with density, 3.9 at 200 players, 9.4 at 500, 18.4 at 1,000); liveChallenges M; distinctUnitsPerPlayer A (bench dense area gave 1.2, sparse reported 142)

rowBytes._tier: M from the 1,000-player default run (out/measured_tables.csv, post-VACUUM, per live row); pushEvent R (G34 rev 2/3: 189 B/row); unitDayState A; unitChallenge is the LIVE tuple size, bloat is separate

movement._tier: R/M: 453 B base and 22 B per cell reported; 7.6 cells fits the measured 621 B per session

retention._tier: A: every retention value is an unratified candidate, including 14/120. summaryDays is the movement_verifications summary row

abuse._tier: A: a hostile account is stopped after activeDays; its accepted rows per day are capped at the unit budget (upper bound: every budgeted unit becomes a ledger row)

churn._tier: burstShare = days of challenge churn that sit as dead tuples at the high-water mark before vacuum catches up, calibrated on the bench at bench speed (default autovacuum 4.4 / 3.3 / 2.7 at 200 / 500 / 1,000 players; aggressive 1.7 / 0.95 / 0.37). People walk far slower than the bench pushes, so this is pessimistic: see params.v1-optimistic.json. unit rows are 98% HOT updates (M), priced by the 2% non-HOT share

wal._tier: M: least-squares through the 200 and 1,000 player runs (predicts the 500 run within 1.5%). retainedDays A: WAL kept on disk after a checkpoint, replica or archive lag

settlement._tier: bytesPerEntry R (6.5 MB / 28,815 rows); ms M (worst settle 472 ms at 7.5k entries per day, 1,000 players); work_mem R (rev 3 SET LOCAL 16 MiB); maxDaysPerRun VERIFIED CODE rules.ts:245
